verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. Recovery: 'sup over (r,z,t) ≤ C' is encoded as '∃ C > 0, ∀ q x, ncard ≤ C', with C chosen before q and x, so the constant is independent of the point exactly as the paper demands ('a constant C, independent of the band and point'); the Lean additionally conjoins Finiteness of the counted set, which the paper's '#' presupposes. The paper's Γ is dropped in pointwise_count (counting all labels, hence at least as strong) and restored verbatim in number_of_relevant_labels_restrict, where restrict_count shows the intersection can only shrink the count. K_γ is encoded two ways: as pointwiseLabels (closed dyadic band support times the A-enlarged slow box, for every fixed enlargement A, covering the paper's 'fixed-factor enlargements' clause), and as the literal closed mask supports PhysicalWaveSum.labelRegion in labelRegion_card_le, which gives the explicit C = 2250; labelRegion_subset_pointwiseLabels shows the first contains the second for A ≥ 1. Lean also quantifies q and x independently rather than imposing q = q(z,t), which is more general, not less.
